claims.value: A finetuned 7 billion parameter Code LLaMA Instruct model designed to generate Solidity smart contracts, trained with 4-bit QLoRA finetuning using the PEFT library on a dataset of 6,003 instruction and code pairs.
claims.evidence: A finetuned 7 billion parameters Code LLaMA - Instruct model to generate Solidity smart contract using 4-bit QLoRA finetuning provided by PEFT library.
